tasks.label: Setup: create .venv and install dependencies
tasks.command: PY=$(command -v python3.13 || command -v python3.12 || command -v python3.11) || { echo 'Python 3.11+ is required (brew install python@3.12)'; exit 1; }; "$PY" -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements-dev.txt && ([ -f .env ] || cp .env.example .env) && echo "Ready: $(.venv/bin/python --version)"

tasks.label: Quality checks: lint + types + tests
tasks.command: .venv/bin/ruff check app tests && .venv/bin/ruff format --check app tests && .venv/bin/mypy app && .venv/bin/pytest
